{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Identify the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
# Use groupby with idxmax to get the index of the row with max sample_seq per patient
df_deduped = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm: we now have one row per patient
n_final_patients = len(df_deduped)

print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {n_final_patients}')"}
